toggleAutoAccept.description: Toggle automatic match accept in the League client

dodgeGame.description: Dodge the current champion select / lobby via LCU API

toggleAutoBan.description: Toggle the auto-ban for a specific champion

toggleAutoPick.description: Toggle the auto-pick for a specific champion

toggleGlobalAutomation.description: Toggle all automation (auto-ban + auto-pick) on or off at once

injectBuild.description: Fetch the best rune page for the current champion and inject it into the League client

getBuilds.description: Fetch available builds for a champion (for property inspector display)
